title: zone-east-2 database connection pool exhausted
description: All application servers in zone-east-2 are failing to acquire database connections. Connection pool is at 100% utilization since 14:10 UTC. Read replicas are also affected. Customer-facing queries are timing out.

title: API gateway returning 504 errors — zone-east-2
description: The API gateway cluster in zone-east-2 started returning 504 Gateway Timeout errors at 14:20 UTC. Approximately 30% of inbound requests are failing. Upstream health checks show zone-east-2 backend services are unreachable.

title: Message queue backlog growing in zone-east-2
description: The RabbitMQ cluster in zone-east-2 has a rapidly growing backlog. Consumer processes are unable to connect to downstream services. Over 500,000 messages are pending. The backlog started building around 14:12 UTC.

title: Request: add monitoring dashboard for zone-east-2 services
description: We'd like a new Grafana dashboard that aggregates key metrics for all zone-east-2 services. Should include latency p99, error rates, and connection pool utilization. Low priority — for the next sprint planning cycle.

title: Scheduled maintenance window for zone-west-1 load balancers
description: Routine maintenance is planned for zone-west-1 load balancers on Saturday 2026-04-19 02:00-04:00 UTC. Traffic will be rerouted to zone-west-2 during the window. No customer impact expected.
